title: WebCatalog Review (2026)
intro: WebCatalog is evaluated here as an adjacent desktop workspace organizer — WebCatalog turns web apps into desktop apps and organises multi-app productivity workspaces. Basic Free covers 2 apps; Pro $5/user/mo annual; Business $8/user/mo annual. 7-day trial. Adjacent productivity shell — not a project management or work OS platform. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s project-management methodology (ease of use, work planning, automation, collaboration, integrations, reporting, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose WebCatalog when organising web apps into desktop workspaces is the productivity job — adjacent to a work OS, never a substitute for one.
verdict: Choose WebCatalog when organising web apps into desktop workspaces is the productivity job — adjacent to a work OS, never a substitute for one. Compare monday/Hive for work management, Foxit for PDF, Getscreen.me for remote access. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, minimums and usage rates on the vendor site before purchase.

faq.question: Is WebCatalog a project management / work OS tool?
faq.answer: No. WebCatalog is an adjacent desktop workspace organizer. It wraps web apps into desktop shells — it is not a project tracker or work OS.

faq.question: How is WebCatalog priced?
faq.answer: Basic Free (2 apps). Pro $5/user/mo annual, Business $8/user/mo annual. 7-day trial. Confirm live.

faq.question: Does WebCatalog have a free plan or free trial?
faq.answer: Yes — a free plan is published. A free trial is documented (about 7 days). Confirm current terms with the vendor.

faq.question: Did SoftwareGlimpse personally test WebCatalog?
faq.answer: No. This review is based on first-party product and pricing research evidence, not hands-on product usage. Affiliate relationships never influence scores.
